text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I just twisted it a little, it's no big deal.
Let's get back to training.
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take a break.
If I think it's too much, I'm stopping you, got it?
If I think it's too much, I'll stop you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I just twisted it a little, it's no big deal.
Let's get back to training.
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take a break.
If I think it's too much, I'm stopping you, got it?
If I think it's too much, I'll stop you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, who do you think you're bossing—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong you are, Senpai,
storming the enemy hideout all alone is taking it way too far!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you talking about?
Senpai literally had a high-speed car chase on foot to catch those kidnappers!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't let yourself get swayed
by stupid rumors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If you've got the pride of being my junior, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
...! My bad!!
I'll follow Senpai with pride from now on!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... With all this racket,
there's no way we can do any training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, that day's training was cancelled, and she took the time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Do you think a puppy gets to boss its owner around?
Hurry up and let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although we continued light-load training
for a while—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, that's enough. Let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's nothin'.
Now hurry up and clear the way for my owner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by the intimidation,
I ended up stepping aside and giving way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I didn't miss the way Sirius Symboli
clenched her fist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should have been firmer
about stopping her.
I can only pray it doesn't get worse..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Sirius Symboli chose was water walking.
This should reduce the strain on her—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Sirius-senpai~!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You guys... what did you come here for?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: I heard you got hurt, Sirius-senpai, and I just couldn't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I haven't fallen so low as to need your pity.
In fact, I've already resumed training.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay!?
You shouldn't push yourself today, you should rest—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think I'd be foolish enough to push myself to the point of no return?
Do you think I can't even manage my own body?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text: I don't... really think so, though.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Then shut up and watch from right there.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
You're right, she's moving fine...
Of course, there's no way Sirius-senpai
would stumble over something like that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
"Strong and stoic as hell.
Sirius-senpai really is the coolest!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together with the juniors, I watched over Sirius Symboli as she trained.
